HLTV and the esportsbooks were read after the published 14:24:32Z snapshot; every value below is quoted as the source displayed it and is not used to re-price a row.

rows.finding: The page displays 3.44 for Ground Zero and 1.24 for Off Chops and names Off Chops the bookmaker favourite at an average of 1.24. That is the same pair behind the published aggregated-reference pick (Off Chops 73.5%).

The page header displays 1.001 / 12.00 and its tips text quotes the bookmaker average as 1.008 / 11.832. A winning bet at 1.001 returns under 2%; the published 92.3% follows arithmetically from a near-lock price and is not an actionable line. The old row rendered this quote as “1.00”, which read as a zero-payout price; presentation is fixed and the number is unchanged.

Displays 1.80 / 1.80 — exactly the same pair displayed on the three other unpriced fixtures below. Four unrelated fixtures cannot all be priced at even money by the same bookmaker average, so the pair is refused as an identical-decimal placeholder, the same rule the pipeline already applies to providers.

rows.verdict: live event, retry the series book
rows.finding: The event is active and its own eventStartTime is 2026-10-25T09:00:00Z, exactly the Hotspawn start, so the fixture is bindable. Its map-1 book is 0.03 / 0.97 (spread 0.94). The publisher reported “no unique exact-name, exact-start-time fixture” for this card, so the next four-hour collect should retry this event's series market rather than treating it as unlisted.

HLTV displays 77.1% HOTU / 22.9% The Huns. That is HLTV's own estimate, not a betting line, and it is not an input to the published 94.1% Valve-rating estimate. The gap is published so a reader can see that the model is materially more confident than HLTV on this fixture.
HLTV displays 81.6% 1win / 18.4% 5star, close to the published 82.2% Valve-rating estimate for 1WIN. Recorded as a cross-check; it changes no probability.

HLTV lists Spirit Academy vs LFO 10 in CCT Europe Series 12 on 25 October, and LFO 10 is a Swedish team. The Bovada page behind the published pick names the opponent “Sokerorg” at 08:00 ET (12:00Z), the same slot, and the scoped alias registry already carries Sökerorg → LFO 10 for this competition. The join is competition-scoped; it is never treated as a global rename.

The published pick links a Bovada page whose URL path says series-11 while Hotspawn lists the fixture in CCT Europe 2026 Series #12. The provider's own path segment is not proof of the wrong fixture (the same provider labels the Spirit Academy fixture the same way), but the label mismatch stays flagged rather than silently rewritten.
